_comment: Demo preprints for the geometadata plugin. Cover the full WKT palette so the preprint hooks, maps, and embedded HTML metadata can be smoke-tested without writing fixtures by hand.

preprints.title: Urban heat-island sensors deployed in Berlin (Point)
preprints.abstract: A point-located preprint demonstrating Point WKT coverage for a single sensor field in Berlin, Germany. Version 2 expanded the original pilot site at Alexanderplatz to a multi-site campaign across central Berlin districts.

versions.title: Urban heat-island pilot sensor at Berlin Alexanderplatz
versions.abstract: Pilot deployment of a single low-cost air-temperature sensor at Berlin Alexanderplatz, covering summer 2023. Preliminary observations only.
versions.notes: v1 reported a single pilot sensor location. Geometry refinement deferred to the per-version-geometadata schema change.

versions.title: Urban heat-island sensors deployed in Berlin (Point)
versions.abstract: A point-located preprint demonstrating Point WKT coverage for a single sensor field in Berlin, Germany. Version 2 expanded the original pilot site at Alexanderplatz to a multi-site campaign across central Berlin districts.
versions.notes: v2 added three additional sensor sites; current PreprintGeometadata reflects the post-refinement footprint.

preprints.title: Coastal walking transect from Sydney to Botany Bay (LineString)
preprints.abstract: LineString example covering a coastal transect along the Sydney metropolitan shore.

preprints.title: Continental-scale habitat suitability for European bison (Polygon)
preprints.abstract: Continental polygon coverage demonstrating broad-scale spatial extent. Version 2 tightened the study area to the realised range across Central and Eastern Europe.

versions.title: Habitat suitability for European bison: continental bounding box (Polygon)
versions.abstract: Initial submission with a coarse rectangular bounding box covering all of Europe to scope the modelling exercise.
versions.notes: v1 used a coarse rectangular bounding box. Geometry refinement deferred.

versions.title: Continental-scale habitat suitability for European bison (Polygon)
versions.abstract: Continental polygon coverage demonstrating broad-scale spatial extent. Version 2 tightened the study area to the realised range across Central and Eastern Europe.
versions.notes: v2 refined the polygon to the realised European bison range; current PreprintGeometadata reflects the refined extent.

preprints.title: Land use mosaic with enclave reserve (Polygon with hole)
preprints.abstract: Polygon-with-hole example. The interior ring represents a protected reserve excluded from the surveyed area.

geometadata.place_name: Hypothetical study area with protected enclave

preprints.title: Capital-cities air quality sample sites (MultiPoint)
preprints.abstract: MultiPoint example covering distributed air-quality sampling sites in four European capitals.

preprints.title: Two parallel river reaches in the southern US and Central Europe (MultiLineString)
preprints.abstract: MultiLineString example. Two disjoint river reaches sampled with the same protocol.

geometadata.place_name: Southern US and Central European reaches

preprints.title: Disjoint North-Atlantic island archipelago survey (MultiPolygon)
preprints.abstract: MultiPolygon example. Two non-contiguous islands surveyed in the same campaign.

preprints.title: Lake Zurich shoreline survey: combined point and transect (GeometryCollection)
preprints.abstract: GeometryCollection example combining a single point of interest with a connected transect.

preprints.title: Holocene shoreline reconstruction with named period (deep time)
preprints.abstract: Open-end temporal example using a named historical period (Holocene).

preprints.title: Pacific antimeridian seabird tracking band (Polygon, antimeridian)
preprints.abstract: Polygon spanning the antimeridian. Demonstrates that the plugin handles features that cross ±180°.

preprints.title: Multi-period climate proxy compilation
preprints.abstract: Demonstrates a preprint with two non-contiguous study periods.

preprints.title: Open-end study of contemporary glacier retreat (open temporal end)
preprints.abstract: Demonstrates an ongoing study with a fixed start and unspecified end.

preprints.title: Crowdsourced air-temperature monitoring across central Europe: preliminary PALM evaluation
preprints.abstract: Preprint version of an evaluation study for the PALM urban microscale model using a crowdsourced air-temperature dataset. The same work was subsequently submitted to and published in the journal.
preprints.linked_article_title: Crowdsourcing air temperature data for the evaluation of the urban microscale model PALM - a case study in central Europe

preprints.title: pIRIR dating of volcanic sediments from Sulawesi: a preliminary report
preprints.abstract: Preprint version of preliminary pIRIR dating results from Sulawesi volcanic sediments, later published as a journal article with expanded analyses.
preprints.linked_article_title: Survival of the brightest: pIRIR dating of volcanic sediments in Sulawesi, Indonesia, using micro-aliquots of K-rich feldspar

preprints.title: Sea-ice extent in the Beaufort Gyre (Polygon, under review)
preprints.abstract: Preprint currently in the moderation queue. Polygon coverage over the Beaufort Gyre study area.

preprints.title: Urban tree canopy survey in Curitiba, Brazil (Point, under review)
preprints.abstract: Preprint currently in the moderation queue. Point-located survey of street trees in central Curitiba.
